meta.scope: Senior/staff (L5/E5-equivalent) software engineer estimated annual total compensation (base + bonus + equity), mid-point of realistic offers
meta.notes: Ranks 14-26 are within each other's error bars. 'remote-eu' eligibility by country changes frequently; verify per posting. ATS vendors and slugs change often; verify before scripting.

companies.name: Meta Platforms
companies.reason: US-band, RSU-heavy packages (~40-50% equity) in Berlin make it the clear German market ceiling.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.reason: New Munich office imports near-US AI-lab compensation with large equity grants; sparse German data, wide error bars.

companies.name: Google
companies.reason: Munich/Berlin engineering on global L5 bands with substantial GSU grants and bonus.

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.reason: AI-boom stock appreciation makes its Munich/Berlin RSU grants the richest of the hardware players.

companies.name: Stripe
companies.reason: Pays near-uniform global-tier comp with high cash base plus equity to engineers it employs remotely in Germany.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.reason: Pre-/post-IPO equity on top of strong base puts Berlin L5s near EUR 190K.

companies.name: Snowflake
companies.reason: US data-cloud bands applied to its Berlin engineering hub, equity-heavy.

companies.name: Coinbase
companies.reason: Remote-first with location-agnostic-leaning bands; crypto comp cycles push senior offers well above EU norms.

companies.name: Apple
companies.reason: Munich silicon/engineering hub pays large RSU refreshers atop solid base.

companies.name: Amazon (incl. AWS)
companies.reason: Berlin, Munich, Dresden and Aachen hubs; L6 senior SDE packages with back-loaded RSUs.

companies.name: Grammarly
companies.reason: Berlin hub on near-US bands with meaningful equity for a profitable private company.

companies.name: Pinterest
companies.reason: Berlin engineering office inherits US public-company RSU structure.

companies.name: Wayfair
companies.reason: Berlin is its largest non-US engineering hub and a long-time top payer in the city (median ~EUR 147K).

companies.name: Datadog
companies.reason: High-growth observability margins fund US-style equity for remote-EMEA and German engineers.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.reason: Munich/Berlin roles with stock and bonus; senior/principal clears EUR 140K+.

companies.name: Helsing
companies.reason: Defense-AI funding boom lets it outbid the Munich market with aggressive equity.

companies.name: Confluent
companies.reason: Public-company RSUs plus remote-Germany hiring on US-anchored bands.

companies.name: Vercel
companies.reason: Frontier dev-tools startup paying SF-anchored cash plus equity to remote EU engineers.

companies.name: GitHub
companies.reason: Microsoft-backed, remote across the EU with stock on top of strong base.

companies.name: Shopify
companies.reason: Remote 'digital by design' with RSU-flexible comp framework for German hires.

companies.name: GitLab
companies.reason: All-remote with a transparent location-factor calculator; Germany lands in the upper band.

companies.name: Elastic
companies.reason: Distributed-first since founding (German roots), pays equity to remote German seniors.

companies.name: MongoDB
companies.reason: Public-company RSUs with remote-Germany engineering hiring.

companies.name: HashiCorp (IBM)
companies.reason: Remote-first infra vendor; the IBM acquisition converted equity into cash-rich packages.

companies.name: DeepL
companies.reason: AI-translation unicorn paying top-of-German-market with equity; Cologne/Berlin plus remote-in-Germany.

companies.name: HubSpot
companies.reason: Remote-in-Germany product engineering on Dublin-anchored bands with RSUs.

companies.name: Spotify
companies.reason: Distributed-first within Germany (Berlin entity) with RSU/options choice on top of base.

companies.name: Wolt (DoorDash)
companies.reason: Berlin is a major engineering hub; DoorDash RSUs lift packages above local delivery-tech peers.

companies.name: JetBrains
companies.reason: Highly profitable tooling company paying strong cash at its Munich hub.

companies.name: Trade Republic
companies.reason: Best-paying German fintech for engineers (senior median ~EUR 110K, staff to ~EUR 170K) plus VSOP equity.
